subject: U-CHAIN r2: all six fix items landed, suite green, 13/13 mutants killed
body: Merged the green BASE (origin/review/2026-09-20-tracker-sweep @ ed51fe11, no conflict) and landed all six round-2 fix items on ravidsrk/u-chain as 88a64c90 (fix) + 0dbc669e (evidence): promotion semantics corrected to BASE->DEFAULT with a local-ref-safe ancestry check and restricted lanes described as unable to PROMOTE rather than unable to integrate (F-1); reconstruction artifacts required to be commit-preserving with seed+diff demoted to supplemental per leg1/RESTORE.md (F-2); the contract test rebound to obligation words with bullets whitespace-normalised per the tests/test_architecture.py:923-926 convention (F-3); the negative control re-recorded through evidence-run.py (F-4); the exemplar's adoption made explicit in the citing text with the historical artifact untouched (F-5); and the full suite re-verified on the merged BASE (F-6). Every round-1 Required finding is answered and re-proved: the six mutants the test-adequacy reviewer showed surviving, plus both SPEC-2 requirement-reversing mutants, plus the base revert and four single-bullet deletions, now run 13/13 KILLED with 0 survivors, and the full suite is 1707 tests / OK / exit 0 at head with wtree == head_sha^{tree}, so AC-1..AC-5 are all addressed and validate.py exits 0. Nothing is left inside the spec's scope; parked for the integrator is the PR, build-blind review and merge leg, and the manifest discloses that head_sha names the implementation commit with the evidence-only commit following it, as in round 1.
